title: Polestar Barred from US Market Under Chinese Connected Vehicle Security Rule
detail: Polestar, the Swedish EV brand majority-owned by China's Geely, has been barred from the US market under the Biden-era Chinese connected vehicle security rule, which restricts vehicles with hardware or software linked to Chinese entities from being sold in the US. The ruling sets a significant trade and national security precedent for the EV industry, as other Chinese-affiliated brands may face similar restrictions.

title: Toyota Recalls Over 20,000 EVs Including Lexus and Subaru Models Over Safety Defect
detail: Toyota has issued a recall of more than 20,000 electric vehicles, including badge-engineered Lexus and Subaru variants, due to a safety defect. The recall highlights ongoing quality and reliability challenges in the EV sector as automakers scale up production of battery-electric vehicles across multiple brands and platforms.
